cases.statement: One carrier linked by the pipeline, known only from a one-line literature table in PMID 39845949 (Table 2 case 7): a Chinese woman, onset at 10 years, age 29, with cerebral venous thrombosis, cerebral infarction and hemiplegia. The table's blanket note says all cases were heterozygous. The primary source is the table's reference (17), He et al. 2020 (PMID 32514655 in the reference list), which is not in this batch. The review 39125844 also lists Lys564Ter (protein only, no cDNA) from the same primary paper, as a family with several affected members; those people are not rows in this batch.

people.label: Table 2 #7
people.key_phenotypes: onset at 10 years; cerebral venous thrombosis; cerebral infarction; hemiplegia

quotes.quote: | 7 | 10 years/29 years | F/Chinese | c.1690A>T, p.Lys564* | Between the 3^rd & 4^th ZnF | Cerebral venous thrombosis, cerebral infarction, & hemiplegia | GC & CPA | (17) |
The genotype of all cases was heterozygous.

phenotype_specificity.statement: No case description in 39845949. The table lists only HA20 patients with brain parenchymal lesions or abnormal CSF findings; it gives no information on other causes considered or excluded.

quotes.quote: Table 2 shows characteristics of only HA20 patients with abnormal lesions in the brain parenchyma or abnormal CSF findings.

segregation.statement: Not reported in 39845949. The review 39125844 describes Lys564Ter (protein only) in a family with several affected members, one with cerebral thrombosis and infarction, citing the same primary paper (He 2020); it does not state which relatives were genotyped.

quotes.quote: Lys564Ter was reported in a family where the affected members developed the disease between 1 month and 10 years of age.
One of them had cerebral thrombosis and infarction, while another patient had intestinal issues, such as diarrhea and inflammation in the colon and ileum.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Single-nucleotide substitution creating a stop codon, p.(Lys564Ter) per the batch HGVS (agrees with the table's p.Lys564*), between zinc fingers 3 and 4 per 39845949 (ZNF3 per 39125844). The paper's general statement on mechanism is reduced A20 expression (haploinsufficiency).

quotes.quote: Expression of the A20 protein encoded by the mutated TNFAIP3 gene is reduced by half, leading to dysregulation of inflammatory cytokines, such as tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α), interleukin-6 (IL-6), and interleukin-1 (IL-1) (2).

concerns: Appears only in literature-review tables without a case description, transcript or cDNA-level family data. The primary report (He 2020, PMID 32514655: reference 17 in 39845949, reference [34] in 39125844) is not in the batch; the panel should read it before adjudicating.

Carriers missing from the batch: 39125844 lists Lys564Ter (no cDNA given) as a family with several affected members (onset '1.5 and 21 years' in its table, '1 month and 10 years' in its text). The pipeline did not link these to this candidate, probably because no cDNA is given. The 39845949 patient (onset 10 years, age 29, cerebral thrombosis and infarction) may be one of that family's members; the ages do not match cleanly.
The domain is given differently: 'Between the 3rd & 4th ZnF' (39845949) versus 'ZNF3' (39125844).
Zygosity rests on 39845949's blanket table note, not a statement about this case.
Transcript not stated; the batch uses NM_001270508.2.
notes_for_panel: Evidence here is review-table rows only. The family described in 39125844 suggests segregation data may exist in the primary paper (He 2020), which is not in this batch.
